DML.SELECT: SELECT audit_log_id as "auditLogId", log_type_id as "logTypeId", log_type_param_id as "logParamId", value as "value", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM rt.audit_log_values WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.audit_log_values (audit_log_id, log_type_id, log_type_param_id, value, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:auditLogId, :logTypeId, :logParamId, :value, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.audit_log_values SET value = :value, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE audit_log_id = :auditLogId AND log_type_id = :logTypeId AND log_type_param_id = :logTypeParamId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.audit_log_values WHERE audit_log_id = :auditLogId AND log_type_id = :logTypeId AND log_type_param_id = :logParamId
